title: Names used by batch p2-G02-3 (GreyNoise Community, SANS ISC / DShield, LeakIX)

attributes.greynoise: GreyNoise Community answer for the IP {state (not_observed | riot | noise | no_flags), noise, riot, classification, name, last_seen, link}; 'not_observed' means not observed scanning by GreyNoise sensors, never 'benign'
attributes.dshield_reports: SANS ISC / DShield sensor reports of the IP {reports, targets, first_seen, last_seen, updated, maxrisk, comment, network}: opportunistic scanning seen by volunteer firewalls, not targeted activity
attributes.isc_threatfeeds: SANS ISC threat-feed memberships of the IP [{feed, first_seen, last_seen, note}] (re-published third-party lists: context, never a verdict or an independent family)
attributes.isc_research_scanner: SANS ISC threat category 'research' entry for the IP {type (scanner operator, e.g. qualys, shodan), added, last_seen}: a known benign research scanner
attributes.isc_asn_reports: SANS ISC per-AS report summary {asn, listed (count of reported addresses returned), reports, targets, top [{ip, reports, targets, first_seen, last_seen}]} (reported addresses are third parties: listed, never auto-expanded)
attributes.leakix_summary: LeakIX metadata counts for the looked-up entity {lookup, detail (full | counts), services, leaks, leaks_by_severity, leaks_by_kind, historical_leaks, unattributed, third_party_counts}; never leaked content
attributes.leakix_exposures: LeakIX leak events reduced to the P274 allowlist and grouped per target/port/plugin [{attribute_to, host, port, protocol, plugin, kind, leak_type, leakix_severity, paths, first_seen, last_seen, events, historical, own_asset}]
attributes.leakix_services: LeakIX service events reduced to the P274 allowlist and grouped per target/port/plugin [{attribute_to, host, port, protocol, plugin, first_seen, last_seen, events}]
